proposal.reason: The main substantive change is to open-source test workflow behavior: dual-platform (M890P + OAM-810E) CI validation, case generation/grouping, scheduler/rack allocation policy, optional HPN SDK installation, result reconciliation/reporting, and CI executor updates (env propagation, dmesg capture, artifacts). File additions with omitted patches are still clearly CI test-list data and generation assets under tests/xtest/test_lists, so no separate module is required.
